rationale: LPLA gapped down ~7.4% on earnings despite a beat, suggesting the market is pricing in disappointment beyond the headline numbers (possibly guidance or margin concerns), and price is sitting near the session low at 14.9% of today's range with no clear stabilization pattern — the last five 1-minute candles show a modest uptick but volume is thin and the stock remains well below VWAP ($278.11).
